title: The wave 1 contract-test harness, its pipeline wiring and the synthetic test data set are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 section R7.2 and section R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 20, 29 and 46; Program v4 NFR-045 and NFR-054; Epic 1 v4 RWB-E1-065
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 16 Test cases
description: No source read gives the repository, environment and namespace of the wave 1 contract-test harness or the pipeline stage it runs in; the tooling beyond the standards that Architecture v5 names (OpenAPI 3.1, AsyncAPI 3.0 with JSON Schema, activity contract jars, Temporal replay, Testcontainers for Kafka and PostgreSQL, a stub set per service); the composition, the volumes, the identifiers and the seed of the synthetic test data set; the fixture lifecycle and its reset; or the gate thresholds and the report format. Architecture v5 slide 46 names the checks and slide 11 says contract tests run in every build, but no source says where the harness lives, how it is wired into the pipeline, what the set contains or how a red check is scored.
evidence: No source read gives these values; Architecture v5 slide 46 names contract tests, replay tests, Testcontainers and the daily journey smoke without giving the harness pack, its environment or its gate, and the wave 1 ITG stories name the RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG set as a precondition without giving its composition
proposed: Agree the harness repository, its environment, namespace and pipeline stage, the tooling beyond the standards, the fixture composition with its volumes, identifiers, seed and business date, the reset mechanism, the report format and the all-green gate with QA, the integration lead and DevOps at the wave 1 entry check, and pin the stub set per build

title: The wave 1 journey harness environment, seeded data, evidence format and release gate are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 section R7.2 and section R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13 to 20, 41 to 44 and 46; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11 to 16; ownership.json api and tables
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness repository, environment and namespace for the wave 1 end-to-end journey, its seeding path, the seeded case beyond the case number RW-2026-000123 that the wave 1 examples carry, the other seeded identifiers, the evidence format and its retention, the wave gate name and any threshold beyond all-green, the gateway-bff composite route path and its merge order, or the P10 agent-run start operation, which the Ownership Map does not list. The fixed business date is the one the wave 1 examples use, the wave gate reads the results recorded for it, and every clock the journey asserts is read from the owner.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners, tables and operations only, Architecture v5 slide 46 names contract tests per API, event and activity, replay tests and a daily journey smoke workflow without giving the harness pack, the environment or the gate, and the wave 1 examples give the business values of the hops only
proposed: Agree the wave 1 harness pack, the seeded case and identifiers, the fixed business date, the evidence format and retention and the all-green gate with QA at the wave entry check, publish the gateway-bff composite route with RWB-PLT-N001-CON, and name the P10 agent-run start operation with the rwb-agent owner
